nodes.name: This September, we come together at Aura just as the estate moves towards harvest. Friends begin arriving from the 20th. Boojee and BESST join us on the 23rd. And for a few days, we walk, taste, make, ask questions, get our hands dirty, eat together and spend time in good company. Then harvest begins.
nodes.text:
This September, we come together at Aura just as the estate moves towards harvest.
Friends begin arriving from the 20th.
Boojee and BESST join us on the 23rd.
And for a few days, we walk, taste, make, ask questions, get our hands dirty, eat together and spend time in good company.
Then harvest begins.

nodes.name: Before everyone comes together, Aura begins to fill slowly. Friends arrive from Singapore and different parts of India. There is no need to rush into a programme. These days are for finding the place.
